## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2018-05-07: S-1/A attaches form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.2
- 2018-05-16: TRA executed at Up-C IPO closing (May 17, 2018 IPO); executed copy filed August 1, 2018 as Exhibit 10.1 to Q2 2018 10-Q

#### Vista take-private and negotiated termination

- 2020-12-11: Amendment No. 1 to TRA executed concurrent with Vista Equity Partners merger agreement; substitutes $127.0M aggregate negotiated payment for the Section 4.01 Early Termination Payment formula
- 2020-12-14: 8-K announces merger and TRA Amendment
- 2021-04-06: Vista's two-step merger closes; $127.0M paid in full satisfaction; TRA terminates; Class A stock delisted and Form 15 filed

## Explanation

Pluralsight, Inc. became the TRA obligor on May 16, 2018 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, with the Continuing Members of Pluralsight Holdings, LLC (founders Aaron Skonnard and Frederick Onion plus other senior managers and Insight Partners vehicles, acting through a Representative) as beneficiaries. The TRA paid 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups on future LLC Unit exchanges; throughout the contract's life the recorded liability was $0 because a full valuation allowance on the underlying deferred tax assets made payments not probable. On December 11, 2020 Pluralsight executed Amendment No. 1 concurrent with Vista Equity Partners' merger agreement, substituting a $127.0M aggregate negotiated payment for the contract's Section 4.01 Early Termination Payment formula and providing for full release of all payment obligations upon Merger consummation; the 8-K described this as a substantial reduction from the formula-driven amount. The Vista merger closed on April 6, 2021, the $127.0M was paid, and the TRA terminated; Pluralsight filed Form 15 to deregister concurrent with delisting. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
